headlines.title: Head of DOJ Civil Rights Division resigns after GOP midterms loss
headlines.description: Harmeet Dhillon oversaw a massive overhaul of the Justice Department’s Civil Rights Division, targeting universities and focusing on culture war issues.

headlines.title: Trump’s D.C.-area arch expected to be approved, but without sniper or drone plans
headlines.description: The National Capital Planning Commission is expected approve the president’s Triumphal Arch for Washington, D.C., with construction scheduled to begin almost immediately.

headlines.title: Hegseth defiant amid impeachment threat
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth put out a new video amid a potential impeachment battle. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: California Governor commutes all death sentences
headlines.description: Governor Gavin Newsom issued the broadest commutation of death sentences in modern American history. In an open letter, Newsom said he’ll reduce every death sentence in the state to life without the possibility of parole. NBC News’ Laura Jarrett has more on what happens next.

headlines.title: Impeaching Trump is 'not our priority,' says Democratic rep-elect
headlines.description: Congresswoman-elect Elaine Luria (D-Va.) joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss how she views the Democrats’ governing mandate and her view on impeachment after previously serving on the January 6th committee.

headlines.title: Democrats won on affordability. Whether they can deliver it is a different story.
headlines.description: Fulfilling a campaign promise to bring down high prices is a lot harder than it sounds. Just ask Donald Trump.

headlines.title: Photos: Celebration and gloom at watch parties across the U.S.
headlines.description: Joy and despair punctuated election watch parties overnight after a blue tsunami swept the country’s midterm elections.

headlines.title: Early midterm voting data shows enthusiasm ahead of election day
headlines.description: With millions of Americans having already voted, NBC News Director of Elections John Lapinski analyzes early midterm voting data and key races to watch on election night.

headlines.title: Sizing up the blue wave: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Democrats are on track for the second-biggest House popular vote edge in the last 50 years. This will also be the largest midterm margin for one party since 1974.

headlines.title: Justice Department moves to toss Steve Bannon’s conviction tied to Congress’ Jan. 6 investigation
headlines.description: The Trump administration moved to vacate the conviction of Steve Bannon on two counts of contempt of Congress in connection with its investigation into the Jan. 6 attack on the U.S.

headlines.title: Democratic socialist Nithya Raman defeats Karen Bass in the L.A. mayor’s race
headlines.description: City Council member Nithya Raman has defeated incumbent Karen Bass in the Los Angeles mayoral race, NBC News projects, capping off a rapid political ascent for a progressive challenger who railed against the “broken status quo” in the country’s second-largest metropolis.

headlines.title: Rep. Ro Khanna allies launch a draft campaign for the 2028 presidential race
headlines.description: Exclusive: The California congressman has been traveling the country and building prominence among progressives.
